heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are authorized to be appropriated to the foundation for carrying out the purposes of this chapter—

tree.text: such sums as may be necessary for each succeeding fiscal year.

notes.text: Amendments2014—Pub. L. 113–237 renumbered section 152611 of this title as this section.
